explanation: An sent messenger or representative of Jesus Christ who was commissioned to spread the gospel.
Actions, miracles, and works performed by the disciples under the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
The event where Jesus was taken up into heaven in a cloud after his ministry on earth.
The Holy Spirit who promised to come upon the disciples to give them power and guidance.
Someone who has seen or experienced something firsthand, especially about Jesus' resurrection, and is to tell it to all nations.
The capital of Judea where the disciples gathered after Jesus' ascension before spreading the message further.
